correctness.rationale: The discrete harmonic stencil identity A_n b=L e_1+R e_n gives A_n K_k=span{L e_j+R e_(n+1-j):1<=j<=k} through floor(n/2); these vectors have disjoint two-coordinate supports. Orthogonal residual projection yields the center sum plus ((R^2-L^2)^2/((L^2+R^2)(n+1)^2))*sum_(j<=k)j^2. Dirichlet sine eigenpairs have nonzero coefficients precisely on odd/even modes determined by L+(-1)^(s+1)R, yielding grades n,ceil(n/2),floor(n/2). For constant forcing the remaining squared residual is max(n-2k,0); for ramp forcing the Krylov image successively removes last coordinates, giving exact sums of squares and relative tolerance limits. Source RESULT.md theorem/proof read; independent rational Gram projections passed 380 cases. No finite check is claimed to prove arbitrary n, preconditioned or floating-point behavior.
